tier_should.rationale: Unique long-term UBI RCT; compelling village-level GE effects and modality contrasts; credible design and measurement; mechanisms plausible. Limitations: early follow-up relative to 12-year promise, mixed human-capital effects, Kenya-specific context. High policy relevance and methodological rigor suit top general-interest outlets.

tier_will.rationale: Star authors and funders, hot UBI policy topic, unusually ambitious long-term RCT with GE estimates, and strong, policy-relevant results. Despite early horizon and external-validity limits, visibility and clarity make top-five placement highly likely.
